# Synthetic Authority Baseline V1

This fixture is deterministic, sanitized, and contains no production customer
truth or production media.  Its reserved `fixture_*` identities exercise
Authority schemas, lineage hashes, immutable approval receipts, content-ledger
novelty, capacity, media-rights separation, operational hold, Mix/News delivery,
patterns, production profiles, and Case human gates.

The fixture is test evidence only.  It is never a fallback Authority source for
runtime code.  Live Authority smoke tests require an explicit
`AIVO_LIVE_AUTHORITY_ROOT` and remain read-only.
